evidence.summary: Run in the foreground; log ends with EXIT_CODE=0. tsc --noEmit and vite build completed (built in 1.36s). Only the existing >500 kB chunk-size warning.

src/App.tsx RootRedirect calls hasAnyCompany(): listCompanies active, then archived=true (server/validation/companySchemas.ts archived filter supported). No company redirects to #/boas-vindas, otherwise #/inicio. src/features/firstRun/WelcomeModePage.tsx shows the welcome copy with no DB, port, login or config screen. AppShell hides nav, mode chip and '?' on /boas-vindas*.

src/features/firstRun/WelcomeCompanyPage.tsx: mode cards navigate to /boas-vindas/empresa?modo=owner|consultant. useWizardForm validates name, segment, sales channel (optional revenue and CNPJ), then createCompany (reused via createdRef on retry), savePreferences({usageMode, focusCompanyId}), startDiagnosis, navigate to /diagnostico/:id. Server field errors map to fields. Retry after a later failure does not re-register the company.

src/features/home/OnboardingTour.tsx TOURS: 5 owner steps, 4 consultant steps, 'N de M' counter, Pular, Voltar, Próximo/Entendi, Esc closes. TourProvider auto-opens once per mode on #/inicio when tourSeen[mode] is false and the first anchor exists. closeTour saves tourSeen for that mode only: client mergeUpdate (src/features/preferences/PreferencesProvider.tsx:31) and server per-key upsert (server/services/preferenceService.ts:96-100) keep the other mode's flag. '?' (tour-reopen) in AppShell calls openTour, navigating to #/inicio first.
